answer: Endorsed tutor agency registration with tutoring association confirmation is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 629 aliases would need 629 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The inlet of the design is public, the forge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the reef of honest work is what finally pays. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
